user.title: Connect to a TCI server
user.description: Enter the address of the computer running Zeus SDR, ExpertSDR or other TCI-capable software. TCI must be enabled in that software.

elements.title: Choose what to expose
elements.description:
Found **{device}** (protocol {protocol}) with {trx_count} receiver(s). Modes: {modes}.

Pick the TCI elements to create as entities. You can change this later under Configure.

data.tx_enabled: Allow Home Assistant to key the transmitter

data_description.tx_enabled: Off by default. Dashboard taps and automations can put the radio on the air. You remain the control operator.
data_description.tx_timeout: Transmissions started from Home Assistant are unkeyed after this many seconds. 0 disables the watchdog.
data_description.sensor_interval_ms: How often the radio sends S-meter and TX meter readings.
data_description.update_interval: Minimum time between Home Assistant state writes for fast meters, to keep the recorder database small. 0 writes every reading.

reconfigure.title: Change TCI server
reconfigure.description: Update the address. The server is probed again so new receivers or modes are picked up.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to a TCI server at that address. Check that TCI is enabled and the port is reachable.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; see the Home Assistant log.
error.no_tx_elements: Select at least one TX control, or turn TX off.

abort.already_configured: This TCI server is already configured.

send_command.name: Send TCI command
send_command.description: Send raw TCI command(s) to the radio, e.g. 'vfo:0,0,14074000;'. Commands that key the transmitter are refused unless TX control is enabled.

command.name: Command
command.description: One or more TCI commands separated by ';'.

config_entry_id.name: Radio
config_entry_id.description: Which TCI radio to send to. Optional when only one is configured.
